about: What Kumi's checks know of Max's objects beyond what a patcher says about them. A class not listed follows Max's convention: only its left inlet is hot. Every list here is an exception to that convention or a fact a rule needs.

inlets.about: Which inlets make an object send: "all", {"hot": [...]} or {"cold": [...]} (every other inlet hot). Code, subpatchers and abstractions decide for themselves, so they count as all hot.

deferred.about: Objects that send later (another scheduler tick, or the low-priority queue), so what they send isn't ordered against the message that reached them.

audio_with_messages.about: Audio objects (named with ~) that answer a message with a message at once; every other ~ object ends a chain of messages.

named.about: Objects whose first argument names something shared by every patcher in Max that uses the name. In Max for Live a name starting with --- is made unique to each copy of the device.

roles.about: What an object is for, as a patcher's colours can show it.
